fields.description: Coraline Beach Residences is a three-tower beach apartment collection on Sobha Siniya Island, Umm Al Quwain. One- to three-bedroom homes include duplex layouts with distinct lower and upper levels. The developer specifically identifies Tower C as fully furnished.

overview: The reviewed three-bedroom duplex separates living areas from upper bedrooms. Its saleable total includes a lower yard and upper balcony, which should be assessed separately from enclosed floor space.
research.locationNote: The developer places Coraline on Sobha Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain. Beach, lagoon and golf-course views are plan-specific; no universal uninterrupted-view promise is assumed.
research.priceNote: The official page displays AED 2.40m subject to inventory availability. Property Finder’s AED 11m launch field is inconsistent with the apartment collection and other sources; it is not used. Lucretia advertises around AED 1.2m for a separate unit selection. Obtain a dated quote for actual stock.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder provides two separate options: 60% construction/40% handover, and 20% booking/40% construction/40% handover. The latter is displayed, without merging schedules. No dated primary calendar was located.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder reports October 2028, while a Lucretia listing updated 30 October 2026 gives March 2028. Only the shared year is displayed. The delivery quarter and individual contract date remain unresolved.
